project.name: OpenGonio (Open Source Gonioreflectometer)
project.description: A printable, modular instrument that measures how materials reflect light, with the software, firmware, build guide, website and paper in one repository.

nodes.name: What the machine measures
nodes.summary: How bright a material looks from every direction of light and view: its BRDF (bidirectional reflectance distribution function). Shiny plastic flashes where light bounces like a mirror; matte paint looks the same from everywhere. The machine records that pattern so a game engine or renderer can copy the real material.

nodes.name: Angles, not pictures
nodes.summary: The camera stays fixed. The lamp swings on an arm (motor M4); the sample table turns (M3), tilts (M2) and spins (M1). Each pose is a pair of angles: where the light comes from and where the camera sees from.

nodes.name: One measurement, start to finish
nodes.summary: A plan lists the poses. The machine homes, moves to each pose, switches the lamp on and takes a bracket of photos. Everything is saved in a run folder with a manifest; `verify` checks it, `curve` turns pixels into numbers and `fit` finds the matching game material.

nodes.name: Making the numbers true
nodes.summary: A mirror finds where zero degrees really is. A dark frame removes the camera's own noise. A white reference turns brightness into reflectance. Every run keeps a copy of the calibration it used.

nodes.name: Safety comes first
nodes.summary: One 24 V line runs through the e-stop and an over-travel switch. Pressing the e-stop cuts motor power in hardware; a small opto module tells the hub, which pauses the run and makes the machine home again.

nodes.name: Built from modules, no solder
nodes.summary: Printed black ABS parts, M2 screws, plug-in electronic modules, screw terminals and lever connectors. No soldering, drilling, sawing or crimping. Parts come from Digi-Key, Amazon or Adafruit.

nodes.name: Edit one file, everything follows
nodes.summary: A few hand-edited files (parts lists, wiring, build steps, CAD) are the sources of truth. Tools regenerate the README tables, diagrams, build book, website and paper from them; `make check` proves they agree.

nodes.name: 00 · Plan
nodes.summary: Stage 00: Plan. Know what you are building, why, and what to buy. Tests, dry runs and the simulated machine work before any hardware. Printed parts fit first time. Safety: ABS gives off fumes (styrene) while printing: enclosed printer, door shut, in a ventilated room you don't sleep in; open the door only after it cools.

nodes.name: Parts, stage 00
nodes.summary: 12 parts for stage 00: store, price, the spec each part must meet. A source of truth for the README tables and the budget.

nodes.name: 01 · Power
nodes.summary: Stage 01: Power. Wall adapter, e-stop box, wire and lever connectors on the bench, each checked; the power plate printed. Jack and e-stop wired with screw terminals and lever connectors only; nothing soldered; adapter unplugged throughout. 24 V at MOT+ / MOT− with the right polarity, cut by the e-stop. Safety: Only 24 V inside the machine: the wall adapter stays outside it. Before touching any screw terminal: press the e-stop and pull the adapter out of the wall. Wire everything with the adapter unplugged; it goes into the wall last.

nodes.name: Parts, stage 01
nodes.summary: 6 parts for stage 01: store, price, the spec each part must meet. A source of truth for the README tables and the budget.

nodes.name: 02 · Controller and buttons
nodes.summary: Stage 02: Controller and buttons. SKR Pico, keypads, cables, the motor 5-pack and the endstops on the bench; your ESP32-S3 as the hub. Laptop → USB-C → SKR Pico (grblHAL) → motor works on the bench. Membrane keys on the ESP32-S3 hub drive the machine. Safety: Never plug or unplug motors with 24 V on.

nodes.name: Parts, stage 02
nodes.summary: 10 parts for stage 02: store, price, the spec each part must meet. A source of truth for the README tables and the budget.

nodes.name: 03 · Frame
nodes.summary: Stage 03: Frame. Nine printed tiles bolted into one 600 mm deck; every mount already has its pilot hole. Outrigger, camera pillar, scan post and boxes screwed into the deck's pilots.

nodes.name: Parts, stage 03
nodes.summary: 6 parts for stage 03: store, price, the spec each part must meet. A source of truth for the README tables and the budget.

nodes.name: 04 · Light arm (M4)
nodes.summary: Stage 04: Light arm (M4). Light arm turns smoothly on the ring. M4 returns to the same spot every time (≤ 0.1°). Safety: Before touching a motor plug or a screw terminal: press the e-stop and unplug the adapter.

nodes.name: Parts, stage 04
nodes.summary: 8 parts for stage 04: store, price, the spec each part must meet. A source of truth for the README tables and the budget.

nodes.name: 05 · Table (M3)
nodes.summary: Stage 05: Table (M3). Sample table turns on its fixed bolt axle without wobble. M3 returns to the same spot every time (≤ 0.1°). Safety: Before touching a motor plug or a screw terminal: press the e-stop and unplug the adapter.

nodes.name: Parts, stage 05
nodes.summary: 7 parts for stage 05: store, price, the spec each part must meet. A source of truth for the README tables and the budget.

nodes.name: 06 · Camera and light
nodes.summary: Stage 06: Camera and light. Sharp, fixed-exposure image centred on the sample. Light switches from the laptop, stays cool and steady. First real data proves the angles are right. Safety: Don't stare into the lamp. Before touching a motor plug or a screw terminal: press the e-stop and unplug the adapter.

nodes.name: Parts, stage 06
nodes.summary: 9 parts for stage 06: store, price, the spec each part must meet. A source of truth for the README tables and the budget.

nodes.name: 07 · Calibrate → game material
nodes.summary: Stage 07: Calibrate → game material. Only the lamp lights the sample. Linear brightness and true angles. Values in real reflectance units (1/sr).

nodes.name: Parts, stage 07
nodes.summary: 12 parts for stage 07: store, price, the spec each part must meet. A source of truth for the README tables and the budget.

nodes.name: 08 · Tilt (M2)
nodes.summary: Stage 08: Tilt (M2). Sample tilts without leaving the zero point. All light directions, unattended. Safety: Before touching a motor plug or a screw terminal: press the e-stop and unplug the adapter.

nodes.name: Parts, stage 08
nodes.summary: 7 parts for stage 08: store, price, the spec each part must meet. A source of truth for the README tables and the budget.

nodes.name: 09 · Spin (M1)
nodes.summary: Stage 09: Spin (M1). Sample spins on its own axis (direct drive). Brushed metal: highlight depends on direction. Safety: Before touching a motor plug or a screw terminal: press the e-stop and unplug the adapter.

nodes.name: Parts, stage 09
nodes.summary: 4 parts for stage 09: store, price, the spec each part must meet. A source of truth for the README tables and the budget.

nodes.name: 10 · Colour add-ons (optional)
nodes.summary: Stage 10: Colour add-ons (optional). Colour spectrum of the spot at the zero point; camera stays for images. Polarizers: shine separated from colour. **LED bank BLOCKED**: its driver circuit is unsafe as designed (stage 10 design.md); do not wire or power MSK-01…03 - mark M30.1–M30.3 n/a. Without the bank scans leave out the photometric set.

nodes.name: Parts, stage 10
nodes.summary: 9 parts for stage 10: store, price, the spec each part must meet. A source of truth for the README tables and the budget.

nodes.name: 11 · 3D scan: capture
nodes.summary: Stage 11: 3D scan: capture. Scan camera fixed at 650 mm, object held securely; nothing on the measuring side moves. Every photo's pose known to 0.3 mm. 144 photos (plus the photometric set with the optional LED bank), unattended.

nodes.name: Parts, stage 11
nodes.summary: 5 parts for stage 11: store, price, the spec each part must meet. A source of truth for the README tables and the budget.

nodes.name: 12 · 3D scan: mesh
nodes.summary: Stage 12: 3D scan: mesh. Shape from silhouettes in minutes. Accurate, detailed 3D model.

nodes.name: 13 · Material on the 3D model
nodes.summary: Stage 13: Material on the 3D model. Colour per texel from the scan photos. The scanned object looks real.

nodes.name: 14 · Laptop app
nodes.summary: Stage 14: Laptop app. Connect, jog, home, live camera and run a plan in one browser page. One click per workflow; stopped jobs continue.

nodes.name: 15 · Standalone (no laptop)
nodes.summary: Stage 15: Standalone (no laptop). OLED shows menu and progress (both modes). Pi drives the SKR Pico over USB and grabs camera frames. Buttons choose and run a job; images saved on the Pi.

nodes.name: Parts, stage 15
nodes.summary: 8 parts for stage 15: store, price, the spec each part must meet. A source of truth for the README tables and the budget.

nodes.name: 16 · Release
nodes.summary: Stage 16: Release. A new builder can finish stage 06 from the docs alone. Public, certified open hardware.

nodes.name: 17 · Upgrades (optional)
nodes.summary: Stage 17: Upgrades (optional). Same fit with fewer photos. Concave shapes in the preview. Check against published measurements.

tour.title: What this machine is
tour.description: A desk-sized instrument that measures how materials reflect light, printed and built from modules. Start with the two big ideas, then open the README.

tour.title: How one measurement happens
tour.description: A plan becomes poses, the machine moves and photographs, and a run folder keeps everything. Click each file to read what it does.

tour.title: Making the numbers true
tour.description: Calibration turns pictures into trustworthy numbers. The simulator rehearses the whole chain with no hardware.

tour.title: Built in small stages
tour.description: Each stage adds one working piece and ends with a check: power, controller, frame, light arm, table, camera and light, calibration.

tour.title: Power and safety first
tour.description: The first wires are the power and the e-stop. The walkthrough shows each wire on a drawing of the bench.

tour.title: Two small computers
tour.description: A motor board (SKR Pico, grblHAL) moves the axes; an ESP32-S3 hub reads the buttons and sensors. The laptop talks to both over USB.

tour.title: Driving it
tour.description: The same code runs behind the command line, the control app in the browser and the standalone station.

tour.title: One source, many outputs
